articles.summary: BOULDER, Colorado – February 15, 2024 – OnKure, Inc. today announced the appointment of Samuel Agresta, M.D., M.P.H. as Chief Medical Officer. Dr. Agresta brings more than 15 years of leadership experience in global, oncology drug development from IND to Phase 4 design and execution, approval, medical and regulatory affairs strategic planning.
